description: This file defines an AssetManager class for handling icon assets in an Electron-based desktop application, including loading ICO files, generating icon paths based on theme and size, and managing icon resources.

classes.name: AssetManager
classes.description: Provides static methods to load icons, generate icon paths, and retrieve icon images based on theme, size, and format.

methods.name: loadIcons
methods.description: Asynchronously loads ICO icon files into memory, parsing them into images.

methods.name: appIcon
methods.description: Returns the path to the application icon based on requested size and format.

methods.name: icon
methods.description: Retrieves an icon image or path based on icon name, size, format, and current system theme.
